lines.en: I scuttle sideways, claws feeling out the way.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，我朝你游过去。
lines.en: With a flick of my tail I swim at you.
Six hit points, and I still charge in.

lines.zh: 主人召我出来，我就来了。
lines.en: My master called, and here I am.

lines.zh: 我踩着水底的沙，慢慢逼近。
lines.en: I tread the sandy bottom, closing in.
My claws are too small to grip stone.

lines.zh: 我蹦起来，想扑到你脸上。
lines.en: I leap up, trying to pounce on your face.
In water I am far faster than on land.
I slip behind you, shifting sideways.
I know this seabed under my feet.
When my master fights, I bite along.
I have no nest, only a master.
My claw tips rasp across the coral.
Small as I am, my bite is not soft.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里钻出来，横着走。
lines.en: I squeeze from the crevice and sidestep out.
When the current picks up, I roll over.

lines.zh: 我踩在软泥上，脚印很快没了。
lines.en: I step in soft mud; my prints vanish quickly.

lines.zh: 主人没发话，我自己找路。
lines.en: My master has not spoken; I find my own way.
I squat in a crevice counting bubbles.
My claws tap together like a beat.
With no master calling, I stare at nothing.
I drop nothing; dying leaves nothing.

lines.zh: 水里漂来一片鳞，我夹住。
lines.en: A scale drifts by and I pinch it.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进沙里一半。
lines.en: I bury half of myself in the sand.
Six hit points will not last long.
I comb my shell with my claws.
Sand works into my shell and itches.
My master has not called, so I stay put.
I watch the light swaying above me.

lines.zh: 壳上长了小藤壶，随它去。
lines.en: Barnacles grew on my shell; let them stay.

lines.zh: 我试着举起一块小石子。
lines.en: I try to lift a small pebble.

lines.zh: 潮声一起一落，我跟着晃。
lines.en: The tide rises and falls; I sway along.

lines.zh: 你踩进主人划的水域了。
lines.en: You stepped into my master's waters.
I look up at you and spread my claws.

lines.zh: 你的靴子能盖住我整只。
lines.en: Your boot could cover me completely.
I remember your smell; do not pretend.

lines.zh: 你手里那根棍子，我不怕。
lines.en: That stick in your hand does not scare me.

lines.zh: 我横着挪，把你圈在中间。
lines.en: I sidle around and box you in.
My master says you should be driven off.

lines.zh: 你的影子压下来，我退了半步。
lines.en: Your shadow falls; I back off half a step.

lines.zh: 我夹了一下水，算是警告。
lines.en: I snap the water once as a warning.

lines.zh: 别蹲下，我不喜欢被俯视。
lines.en: Do not crouch; I dislike being looked down on.
My shell cracked; I retreat.

lines.zh: 这一下把我左钳打歪了。
lines.en: That blow bent my left claw crooked.
Six hit points, and every one hurts.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，赶紧爬起来。
lines.en: I flip over and scramble upright.
My claw slips and a shell chip falls.
It hurts, but my master is watching.
I flee sideways and hit a rock.
The water turns red, and it is mine.
Another blow and my shell gives out.
I hiss, and the sound is thin.

lines.zh: 你手里的鱼肉，腥得刺鼻。
lines.en: The fish in your hand reeks sharply.

lines.zh: 我饿了，但主人的命令更硬。
lines.en: I am hungry, but my master's order is harder.

lines.zh: 丢过来，我就当没看见你。
lines.en: Toss it over and I will pretend not to see you.
I do not touch bread; do not waste it.

lines.zh: 一条鱼换我停手？可以谈。
lines.en: One fish for a truce? We can talk.

lines.zh: 我钳子夹着食物，眼还盯着你。
lines.en: I hold the food in my claws, eyes still on you.
Without my master's leave, I cannot accept.

lines.zh: 这点碎肉，塞不住我的钳。
lines.en: This scrap of meat will not fill my claws.
Step farther back, then I will take it.
The taste is good, but loyalty pays better.
Your boot numbed the rim of my shell.
Your bump rolled me onto my back.

lines.zh: 让开，这石头是我先占的。
lines.en: Move; I claimed this rock first.

lines.zh: 我的钳子卡在你靴缝里。
lines.en: My claw is stuck in your boot seam.
Lift your foot; the shell under the sand gives.

lines.zh: 你撞我一下，我夹你一下。
lines.en: You bump me once, I pinch you once.
I scurry sideways around your feet.
You muddied the water and I cannot see.
Back off; my claws will not stop.
This one does not count; the next one will.
A crab like me has no mate.

lines.zh: 主人一挥手，同伴就来了。
lines.en: One wave of my master's claw and kin arrive.
I do not speak of love, only of claws.
Karcinoma counts as half a relative.
We never breed on our own.
Looking for a partner? Ask Karkinos.
I was born a soldier, not a spouse.

lines.zh: 钳子碰钳子，就算打招呼。
lines.en: Claw against claw counts as a greeting.
Kin are summoned here, then summoned away.
The seabed is empty, and a mate emptier still.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，只用钳子夹。
lines.en: I do not pick things up; I only pinch.

lines.zh: 那块鱼肉，我夹一下就走。
lines.en: That fish I will pinch once and leave.

lines.zh: 我没有口袋，也没地方放。
lines.en: I have no pockets and nowhere to store.
Loot drifts by and I shove it away.

lines.zh: 主人掉的钳子，我不敢碰。
lines.en: My master's dropped claw I dare not touch.
I lift a shell and toss it back.

lines.zh: 这枚鳞片太小，不值得拿。
lines.en: This scale is too small to be worth taking.

lines.zh: 我用钳子拨了拨那堆沙子。
lines.en: I poke that pile of sand with my claw.
Carrying things would slow my swimming.
Pick it up yourself; I will keep watch.
I see you and come sideways.
Target set; my claws rise.
Whoever my master points at, I bite.
The water moved; you cannot hide.
You are easier to chase than an iron golem.
I first swim to your flank.
Close enough now; I am going to leap.
Six hit points, one chance.
Run onto land and I will follow.
Found you; do not look back.

lines.zh: 我横着绕，专找你的空档。
lines.en: I circle sideways, hunting a gap in you.
Claws raised, waiting for you to move first.
Coral behind you; you cannot retreat.
I orbit you, closer each turn.
Your armor will not stop my claw tips.
I count bubbles, waiting for you to breathe.
The leap is the hardest part.
Small I may be, but my stare is tight.

lines.zh: 主人从小虾座那边包抄。
lines.en: My master flanks from the other side.
Back half a foot and I sidle a foot.
My claw closes on your shin.
Four points of pain; remember it.
I leap and slam into your chest.
My master taught me this pinch.
My claw tip slices your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你打我一下，我夹你三下。
lines.en: You hit me once; I pinch you three times.
My shell cracks against your knee.
Water splashes; I bite and hold.
Do not shake; my grip is tight.
Even an iron golem's leg I dare to pinch.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋一捏，我就出来了。
lines.en: Crack the egg and out I come.

lines.zh: 主人召我，我从水里冒头。
lines.en: My master calls and I surface.

lines.zh: 没有自然生成，我只能被放出来。
lines.en: No natural spawns; I am only placed.
The moment I land, I look for my master.

lines.zh: 这片水是新的，我先探探。
lines.en: This water is new; let me probe it.
My shell is still wet; I am newly formed.
Where is my master? I turn a full circle.
Six hit points, short from the very start.
I flick droplets from both pincers.
Another one arrives; the swarm grows crowded.
The hot water bleaches my shell white.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，钳子先着地。
lines.en: I fall from a height and land on my claws.
A crab, and I still choke on water.
The blast throws me onto the coral.

lines.zh: 箭尖卡进我背壳的裂缝。
lines.en: An arrowhead lodges in a crack on my back.
That violet light makes my legs weak.
Hunger drags my claws onto the sand.
Lightning strikes and I go numb all over.
There is nothing beneath me anymore.
